run_actor_critic_rnn_test: run the parameterized test that trains an actor-critic RNN agent on bsuite environments for 5 episodes
test_run_method: test the RunTest.test_run method to verify agent training works across bsuite test environments
create_default_agent: create a default actor-critic RNN agent using observation and action specs from a bsuite environment
run_experiment: run an experiment with a given agent and environment for a specified number of episodes
load_bsuite_environment: load a bsuite environment by its ID string using bsuite.load_from_id
